tasks.description:
**Question.** Does subthreshold stimulation of a frontal eye field site make a monkey better at detecting a dimming at the place that site's saccades go (its movement field)?

**What is on the screen.** A dark screen with a fixation point. Once gaze is held, a target square appears at the day's movement field (this set; configs/task-monkey-outside.yaml puts it 90° away about fixation). Same-luminance distractor squares flash for 16 ms every 32 ms, one at a time, at random places outside a [[param:distractor_exclusion_dva]] zone. On a blink trial the target dims for 32-48 ms at a random time [[param:dim_onset_min]]-[[param:dim_onset_max]] after it appears.

**What the subject does.** Holds gaze in the fixation window throughout (eye tracker; leaving it ends the trial). On a blink trial presses the key (standing in for the paper's lever release) within [[param:response_window]] of the dimming, not sooner than [[param:min_rt]]; on a catch trial holds for [[param:catch_duration]].

**Varied.** Stimulation (on or off, as two simultaneous staircases); on stimulation trials a STIM_TRIGGER goes out [[param:stimulation.soa]] before the (would-be) dimming for the lab's stimulator. Dimming depth (% Michelson contrast) is set by a block staircase per condition (2 blink + 1 catch trials per block).

**Measured.** Hits, misses, early responses and false alarms; each staircase's dimming depth by block, fitted for the paper's luminance-change threshold.

**What it can and cannot show.** A lower threshold with stimulation than without, inside but not outside the movement field, would be the paper's result. That needs FEF microstimulation at a mapped site; this folder only sends the trigger. Luminances are in cd/m² only after the rig's photometer values are entered.
notes: Paper: 1 cd/m² background, 26 cd/m² target and distractors, 16-ms flashes every 32 ms, dimming 32-48 ms at 500-1300 ms, 2,100-ms catch trials, 175-ms SOA example, 100-ms 200-Hz train, 2 blink + 1 catch per block.

ASSUMED: example movement field (10, -6) dva, target 0.75 deg² and distractor 0.55 deg² (mid-range), 3.5-dva exclusion, 0.5-dva fixation point, 1.5-dva window radius, 2-s / 200-ms acquisition, 800-ms response deadline, 100-ms minimum RT, key for lever, staircase start/step/floor/blocks, 1-s interval.
Diagram luminances use the example photometry (black 0.3, white 100 cd/m², ASSUMED); measure the rig.
The outside-field set (configs/task-monkey-outside.yaml) moves the target 90° about fixation; the human set (configs/task.yaml) has no stimulation. Neither is a separate task in docs/experiment.json.
